import RNA
import random

target = "(((..(((((((.....((((((...)))))).))))..((((((..(((...)))))).(((((...((((....))))....)))))..)))..)))..(((((((.....(((((....)))))......)))((((((((((...)))))(((((...)))))((((((((..(..(..(..(..(..((((....))))..).)..))..).))(((....)))..))))))...))))))))).(((((.((((......(((((((........((((.....))))))))...))).))))((((......((((((((....))))))..(((((...)).(((((...)))))..)))))....)))))))))...)))"
N = len(target)

def pairs_from_db(db):
    st=[]; p=set()
    for i,c in enumerate(db):
        if c=='(': st.append(i)
        elif c==')':
            j=st.pop(); p.add((j,i))
    return p

target_pairs = pairs_from_db(target)

fc = RNA.fold_compound(target)
fc.sc = None
fc.hc = None

def fold(seq):
    fc2 = RNA.fold_compound(seq)
    mfe, _ = fc2.mfe()
    return mfe

def bpdist(seq):
    db = fold(seq)
    fp = pairs_from_db(db)
    return len(target_pairs ^ fp)

# units (0-indexed, start..end inclusive)
units = [
    (8, 36, "GAGGUCAGUGGACGCGCAGCGUCUCCCUC"),
    (42, 58, "GGUAUGUGAUCCACGCC"),
    (60, 88, "GGGUGUGUGCUCCAGCGGGUUAGUCGCCC"),
    (105, 135, "GGCUUUGUGUAAUAGCGAUUACCUGUAUGCC"),
    (141, 153, "GGGGGUGUCUCUC"),
    (154, 166, "GGGGGUGUCUCUC"),
    (173, 218, "GCGAGGACAUGAACAGGGGCGUCAUAGGAUGGACAGGGCGGACGGC"),
    (219, 228, "CCAGUUGUGG"),
    (256, 308, "CGUGACCGACCUCCGCCAAAACCUUUCGCUAAGUGCGAGGCGCCUGAGACACG"),
    (321, 336, "CCCGUAGUGCUGCGGG"),
    (342, 348, "GCAAAGC"),
    (350, 362, "GGGGGUGUCUCUC"),
]

seq = list('A'*N)
# fill junction closing pairs with GC
gc = [(2,386),(7,96),(41,91),(104,245),(140,240),(172,231),(254,378),(320,368),(341,365)]
for a,b in gc:
    seq[a]='G'; seq[b]='C'
for s,e,u in units:
    for i,c in enumerate(u):
        seq[s+i]=c
seq = ''.join(seq)
print("init dist:", bpdist(seq), "len", len(seq))

# Simulated annealing with target-aware moves
best = seq
bestd = bpdist(seq)
cur = seq
curd = bestd
random.seed(1)
import math
T = 2.0
for it in range(200000):
    # pick a random position; bias toward mismatched
    db = fold(cur)
    fp = pairs_from_db(db)
    missing = list(target_pairs - fp)
    spurious = list(fp - target_pairs)
    # positions to fix
    cands = set()
    for a,b in missing[:20]:
        cands.add(a); cands.add(b)
    for a,b in spurious[:20]:
        cands.add(a); cands.add(b)
    cands = [c for c in cands if c < N]
    if not cands:
        cands = list(range(N))
    pos = random.choice(cands)
    old = cur[pos]
    new = random.choice([b for b in 'ACGU' if b != old])
    cand = cur[:pos] + new + cur[pos+1:]
    d = bpdist(cand)
    if d <= curd or random.random() < math.exp((curd - d)/T):
        cur = cand; curd = d
        if d < bestd:
            best = cand; bestd = d
            if d == 0:
                print("SOLVED at it", it)
                break
    if it % 5000 == 0:
        print(it, "best", bestd, "cur", curd, "T", T)
    T *= 0.99995

print("FINAL best dist:", bestd)
print(best)
